translations.text: "Tell me how great a host there was in all of Pharaoh's army, when in enmity they began [?] to pursue God's people."

"I do not know it in any way, except that I think this: that there were chariots there, counted out by number, six hundred [?] of armed men; the wave took all of that away, by a cruel fate, in the kingdom of the world."
